import io,json,subprocess,tarfile,time,urllib.request
container="debug-ai-debug-ai-1"
bid="realdebug_fcd5c8934718474a8c217f818b0d5366"
base="http://127.0.0.1:8787"
def get(path):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(base+path,timeout=5) as r:
        return json.load(r)
def suite():
    return get("/v1/investigation-benchmark/status/"+bid)
s=suite()
assert s["benchmark_id"]==bid and s["summary"]["total"]==50
if s["active_in_process"]:
    raw=subprocess.check_output(["docker","cp",container+":/app/runtime/durable/durable/run-state-v2","-"])
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw)) as a:
        states=[json.load(a.extractfile(m))["payload"] for m in a.getmembers() if m.isfile() and m.name.endswith(".json")]
    live=[r for r in states if r.get("job_status") in ("QUEUED","RUNNING","RETRY_WAIT")]
    current=suite().get("current") or {}
    case=current.get("case_id")
    assert case and all(r["run_id"]==current.get("run_id") and r["project_id"]=="debugai-real-debug-"+case and r["project_dir"].endswith("/debug-ai/.verification/real-debug/"+bid+"/"+case) for r in live), "UNRELATED_ACTIVE_RUN_OR_CHANGED_OWNER"
    subprocess.run(["docker","restart","--time","10",container],check=True,timeout=30)
    for _ in range(25):
        try:
            if get("/health")["ok"]: break
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(1)
    else: raise RuntimeError("DEBUGAI_HEALTH_NOT_READY")
s=suite()
assert s["active_in_process"] is False
assert s["state"] in ("PAUSED","INCOMPLETE","DONE","RUNNING")
if s.get("current") and s["current"].get("run_id"):
    d=get("/v1/status/"+s["current"]["run_id"])["durable"]
    assert d["active_in_process"] is False and d["job_status"] not in ("RUNNING","QUEUED","RETRY_WAIT")
    print("CHILD",d["job_status"],d["active_in_process"])
print("SUITE",s["state"],s["active_in_process"],s["summary"]["completed"],s.get("pause_reason"))
print("HEALTH",get("/health")["ok"])
PY
